review.vietnamese: Original complete-phrase cuts selected using word-level original CC and context; 14 additions also machine-transcribed with local Whisper. Four contradictory/incomplete candidates excluded. Automatic CC/ASR is not independent listening certification.
review.khmer: Authored Azure Khmer situation cues, with explicit script/sample/hash provenance and live eligibility gates. Original-source Khmer names and greeting retained. Failed Seed-VC conversion trials are excluded. Native pronunciation/listening not independently verified.
review.percussion: Recorded field transients during a gap in recognised commentary; filtered and faded, not isolated studio drum stems.
review.rights: Source attributed to broadcaster. No permission or reusable-content licence has been independently verified.
review.speakers: Vietnamese commentary is original broadcast speech only, with no synthesis, conversion, pitch shift, speed change or syllable assembly. Khmer situation cues use pre-rendered Azure Piseth Neural. Original Khmer team names and greeting remain broadcast recordings. No commentator clone is claimed.
review.teamNames: Name identities were matched manually against the registration roster, local aliases and surrounding race/team context in automatic CC. Original speech only; no assembled syllables, invented team numbers or runtime TTS. Shared pagoda-name cuts contain no gender/entry claim; numbered cuts are used only for that number. Proper-name spelling in automatic CC can be wrong; this is not independent listening verification.
review.teamHistory: Only complete original commentary phrases with externally corroborated 2024 results. Historical standings are restricted to the identified entry/gender, never used to decide a game result. Missing names/history remain explicitly unavailable; absent CC is not proof the audio never speaks that name.
review.multiSeason: Four complete hashed original recordings from 2023, 2024 and 2025. Video upload dates are separate from event years. Search references/candidate captions never automatically enter the runtime.
review.asr: Local faster-whisper large-v3-turbo and public Vatho/Khmer-ocm were tried on bounded excerpts. Results can hallucinate, especially short/music/bilingual contexts. Selected additions retain raw CC plus relevant machine evidence; inconclusive/contradictory candidates are excluded. This is not an independent listening or speaker-identity certification.
review.stages: Per-recording eligibility is rechecked against actual player distance/pace/effort/gap/result, including after decoding. Generic event arrays are alternatives. Current excerpts finish before an urgent queued cue; stale/ineligible cues and rapid duplicate excerpts are skipped. No judge-wait statement is played after a confirmed tie. Recent phrases are excluded before alternative selection. Short countdown/start cues must fit their actual scheduling deadlines.

ai-ready-km.text: ត្រៀមខ្លួន!

ai-go-km.text: ចាប់ផ្តើមហើយ!

ai-cruise-km.text: ឥឡូវត្រូវរក្សាចង្វាក់អុំឱ្យស្មើគ្នា។
ai-cruise-km.translationVi: Bước vào đường trường. Giữ đều nhịp dầm!

ai-halfway-km.text: បានឆ្លងកាត់ពាក់កណ្តាលផ្លូវហើយ។ ត្រូវទុកកម្លាំងសម្រាប់ចុងផ្លូវ!
ai-halfway-km.translationVi: Đã qua nửa đường đua. Còn sức cho đoạn cuối!

ai-close-race-km.text: ទូកទាំងពីរកំពុងប្រកៀកប្រកិតគ្នា!
ai-close-race-km.translationVi: Hai ghe đang so kè! Chưa có cách biệt rõ ràng!

ai-lead-change-km.text: មានការវ៉ាឡើងមុខ! ទូកនាំមុខបានផ្លាស់ប្តូរហើយ!
ai-lead-change-km.translationVi: Vừa có pha vượt lên! Ngôi dẫn đầu đã đổi!

ai-cohesion-km.text: ចង្វាក់អុំស្មើគ្នាល្អណាស់!
ai-cohesion-km.translationVi: Nhịp dầm đang rất đều! Cả đội phối hợp nhịp nhàng!

ai-recover-km.text: បន្ថយចង្វាក់ ដើម្បីទុកកម្លាំងសម្រាប់ចុងផ្លូវ។
ai-recover-km.translationVi: Giảm nhịp để giữ sức cho chặng cuối.

ai-final-km.text: ដល់ដំណាក់កាលចុងក្រោយហើយ! បង្កើនល្បឿន!
ai-final-km.translationVi: Vào đoạn nước rút! Tăng nhịp dầm!

ai-surge-km.text: ប្រឹងអស់កម្លាំង!

ai-last-hundred-km.text: ១០០ ម៉ែត្រចុងក្រោយ!

ai-last-fifty-km.text: ៥០ ម៉ែត្រចុងក្រោយ!

ai-finish-win-km.text: ដល់ទីហើយ! សូមអបអរសាទរក្រុមដែលឈ្នះជើងប្រណាំងនេះ!
ai-finish-win-km.translationVi: Đã về đích! Xin chúc mừng đội thắng lượt đua này!

ai-finish-loss-km.text: គួរឱ្យសោកស្តាយ! គូប្រកួតបានដល់ទីមុន ក្នុងជើងប្រណាំងនេះ។
ai-finish-loss-km.translationVi: Rất tiếc! Đối thủ đã về đích trước trong lượt này.

ai-finish-tie-km.text: លទ្ធផលស្មើគ្នា! ទូកទាំងពីរដល់ទីប្រកៀកប្រកិតគ្នា!
ai-finish-tie-km.translationVi: Kết quả hòa! Hai ghe kết thúc sát nhau!

ai-finish-dnf-km.text: គួរឱ្យសោកស្តាយ ក្រុមមួយមិនបានបញ្ចប់ជើងប្រណាំងនេះទេ។
ai-finish-dnf-km.translationVi: Rất tiếc, một đội đã không hoàn thành lượt đua.
